# Charts

Area, bar, donut, candlestick, heatmap and sparkline, as plain SVG.

[AreaChart](#areachart) · [BarChart](#barchart) · [DonutChart](#donutchart) · [CandlestickChart](#candlestickchart) · [Heatmap](#heatmap) · [Sparkline](#sparkline)

### AreaChart

A line chart with optional filled area, several series, a crosshair and a tooltip. Plain SVG, sized to its container.

```ts
import { AreaChart } from '@/kit/components/charts/AreaChart'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` *(required)* | `{ id; label; data: { x: Date; y: number }[]; color?; area?; dashed? }[]` |  | Lines to draw. All series share the first one’s x values. |
| `height` | `number` | `280` | Height in px. |
| `formatY` | `(n: number) => string` |  | Y axis and tooltip number format. |
| `formatX` | `(d: Date) => string` |  | X axis label format. |
| `formatTip` | `(d: Date) => string` |  | Tooltip title format. |
| `smooth` | `boolean` | `true` | Monotone curve instead of straight segments. |
| `onHover` | `() => void` |  | Called when the reader hovers the chart or steps through it with the arrow keys. |
| `ariaLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Describes the chart for screen readers. |

```tsx
<AreaChart ariaLabel="Portfolio value" series={[{ id: 'p', label: 'Portfolio', data, area: true }]} formatY={(n) => fmt.moneyCompact(n)} />
```

- Hover, or focus the chart and use ← →, to read any point; Esc hides the readout.
- Colors come from `--chart-1…5`; pass any CSS color per series to override.

### BarChart

Grouped bars with a legend and a hover band.

```ts
import { BarChart } from '@/kit/components/charts/BarChart'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` *(required)* | `{ label: string; values: Record<string, number> }[]` |  | One entry per group on the x axis. |
| `series` *(required)* | `{ key: string; label: string; color?: string }[]` |  | The bars in each group; `key` reads from `values`. |
| `height` | `number` | `260` | Height in px. |
| `formatY` | `(n: number) => string` |  | Axis and tooltip format. |
| `ariaLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Describes the chart for screen readers. |

```tsx
<BarChart ariaLabel="Income and spending" data={months} series={[{ key: 'income', label: 'Income' }, { key: 'spend', label: 'Spending' }]} />
```

### DonutChart

A donut with a hover-linked legend and a center readout.

```ts
import { DonutChart } from '@/kit/components/charts/DonutChart'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slices` *(required)* | `{ id: string; label: string; value: number; color?: string }[]` |  | The parts of the whole. |
| `size` | `number` | `176` | Diameter in px. |
| `thickness` | `number` | `16` | Ring width in px. |
| `centerLabel` | `ReactNode` |  | Small text in the middle. |
| `centerValue` | `ReactNode` |  | Big text in the middle. Hovering a slice shows its label and value instead. |
| `formatValue` | `(n: number) => string` |  | Value format in the legend. |
| `activeId` | `string \| null` |  | Highlighted slice. Leave out to let the chart manage hovering itself; pass it with `onActiveChange` to link the donut to other UI. |
| `onActiveChange` | `(id: string \| null) => void` |  | Called with the slice id under the pointer, or null when it leaves. |
| `ariaLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Describes the chart for screen readers. |

```tsx
<DonutChart ariaLabel="Allocation" slices={slices} centerLabel="Total" centerValue="$152k" formatValue={(n) => fmt.money(n, 0)} />

// linked to a table: hovering a slice highlights its rows, hovering a row highlights its slice
const [linked, setLinked] = useState<string | null>(null)
<DonutChart activeId={linked} onActiveChange={setLinked} … />
```

### CandlestickChart

OHLC candles with a volume strip and a readout.

```ts
import { CandlestickChart } from '@/kit/components/charts/CandlestickChart'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` *(required)* | `{ x: Date; o; h; l; c; v }[]` |  | Open, high, low, close and volume per period. |
| `height` | `number` | `380` | Height in px. |
| `formatY` | `(n: number) => string` |  | Price format. |
| `formatX` | `(d: Date) => string` |  | Date format. |
| `formatVolume` | `(n: number) => string` |  | Volume format. |
| `ariaLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Describes the chart for screen readers. |

```tsx
<CandlestickChart ariaLabel="AAPL daily candles" data={candles} formatVolume={(n) => fmt.compact(n)} />
```

- Up candles use `--success`, down candles `--error`.

### Heatmap

A calendar heatmap of daily gains (green) and losses (red).

```ts
import { Heatmap } from '@/kit/components/charts/Heatmap'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` *(required)* | `Record<string, number>` |  | Daily values keyed by YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `from` *(required)* | `Date` |  | First day shown. |
| `to` *(required)* | `Date` |  | Last day shown. |
| `formatValue` *(required)* | `(n: number) => string` |  | Tooltip value format. |
| `ariaLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Describes the chart for screen readers. |

```tsx
<Heatmap ariaLabel="Daily gains and losses" data={pnl} from={start} to={end} formatValue={(n) => fmt.moneySigned(n, 0)} />
```

- Starts scrolled to the most recent weeks. The week starts on the day set in the theme config.

### Sparkline

A tiny trend line for tables and cards. Decorative: pair it with a text value.

```ts
import { Sparkline } from '@/kit/components/charts/Sparkline'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` *(required)* | `number[]` |  | Values, oldest first. Needs at least two. |
| `width` | `number` | `88` | Width in px. |
| `height` | `number` | `28` | Height in px. |
| `color` | `string` |  | Line color. Green when the series ends higher than it began, red otherwise. |
| `fill` | `boolean` | `true` | Soft fill under the line. |

```tsx
<Sparkline data={prices.slice(-30)} />
```
